description: This source file implements the RtXcastConnector class, which manages remote casting services including establishing connections, handling application launch/stop/hide/state/resume requests, managing application registration, and interacting with remote services via the rtRemote API. It includes callback functions, connection management, and various control methods for cast applications.

classes.name: RtXcastConnector
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing remote casting connections, handling application lifecycle events, and communicating with the remote service via rtRemote APIs.

methods.name: remoteDisconnectCallback
methods.description: Callback for remote disconnect events, notifies observer about disconnection.

methods.name: processRtMessages
methods.description: Event loop processing incoming rtRemote messages.

methods.name: threadRun
methods.description: Thread function that runs the message processing loop.

methods.name: onApplicationLaunchRequestCallback
methods.description: Handles application launch requests from remote clients.

methods.name: onRtServiceByeCallback
methods.description: Handles upstream notification that remote service has exited.

methods.name: connectToRemoteService
methods.description: Attempts to locate and connect to the remote rtRemote service.

methods.name: applicationStateChanged
methods.description: Notifies remote service of application state changes.

methods.name: enableCastService
methods.description: Enables or disables the cast service with a given friendly name.

methods.name: updateFriendlyName
methods.description: Updates the friendly name used in the cast service.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the protocol version of the cast service.

methods.name: registerApplications
methods.description: Registers a list of applications with the cast service.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RtXcastConnector.

methods.name: IsDynamicAppListEnabled
methods.description: Checks if dynamic application list feature is enabled via RFC parameters.

methods.name: IsAppEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific application is enabled via RFC parameters.
